{{Youmay|the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]|the [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Ajax Wennel]] or the [[Droid]] named [[Ajax Sigma]]}}
{{Image}}
The '''''Ajax''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that was involved in the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]. It ended up severely damaged alongside the [[Formidable/Legends|''Formidable'']] after [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] unloaded their [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] onto their [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].
